projectDescription: Lemonado is an AI-native marketing data platform that unifies ad platforms, analytics, and revenue data into a single queryable layer, enabling marketing teams and agencies to chat with their data, build dashboards, run automated reports, and connect live data to AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT via MCP.
keyFeatures: Collaborative AI chat across all connected marketing data sources
Studio — AI-built dashboards and reports on live, real-time data
Creative analytics with fatigue scores, hook scores, and cross-platform pivots
Proactive agents for spend monitoring, anomaly detection, and morning digests
Custom MCP connectors to expose governed live data to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and more
Client workspaces with persistent memory and scoped data access
Automated report scheduling delivered to Slack or email
White-label reports with custom branding for agencies
Unified SQL query engine across all connected platforms
Read-only, GDPR-compliant data layer hosted in the EU
publicApiSurface: Bearer token authentication for MCP connections

Real-time data connectors: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics, Stripe, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Google Sheets, CSV, Google Search Console, YouTube, Sharetribe, WhatConverts, Instagram Organic, Facebook Organic
